answer_1.quote: Speech translation aims at converting speech from one language into speech or text in another language.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate both the translation quality and the speech quality of the system output. To evaluate the translation quality, we follow the setup in ... compute BLEU using SACREBLEU ... we see a character error rate (CER) of 4.5 ...

answer_4.quote: we conduct human listening tests to collect mean opinion scores (MOS) to evaluate the naturalness of the speech output. We randomly sample 200 utterances from the test set, and each sample is rated by 8 raters on a scale of 1-5, with 1 being the worst and 5 being the best.
answer_4.guideline: Raters score the naturalness of speech output on a scale of 1-5.
